pages.title: Your first point
pages.text: Earn discovery XP from new mining, crafting, smelting, fishing and trading results. Kills also grant XP. The first level costs 100 XP and awards one point.

pages.title: Spend it
pages.text: Find Open Point-Buy Screen in Controls. Choose the flat line for attack, health or movement speed and click +1 to see the change.

pages.title: Craft this guide
pages.text: One book, one gold ingot and one experience crystal.
